# ankra_cluster (Data Source)

One cluster of the organisation, looked up by `id` or by exact `name`, with its kind and state. The counterpart of `ankra cluster info`. Feeds the `cluster_id` of the cluster settings resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cluster" "prod" {
  name = "prod"
}

output "prod_kind" {
  value = data.ankra_cluster.prod.kind
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.
- `name` (String) Exact name of the cluster. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.

### Read-Only

- `kind` (String) Cluster kind: `imported`, `hetzner`, `ovh`, `upcloud`, ...
- `state` (String) Cluster state.
